notes.title: Version 1.05 released - Achievements added!
notes.notes:
Version 1.05 of the game has been released!
Changes:

- NEW: Steam Achivements have been added!
- FIX: Rare 'black screen' issue when entering city has been fixed.

Enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Version 1.01 released!
notes.notes:
This version fixes a few rare issues with the game encountered by users.
- Fixes a rare issue with the Lazy Sheep quest that caused it to either trigger too soon or disappear and not trigger at all.
- (Probable) Fixed a very rare issue with game crashes after 10-15 minutes of gameplay on very specific systems.
- (Probable) Fixed a rare issue with traveling to the main city for the first time and the screen just pops up black and you are unable to move or go anywhere.
- TWEAK: Improved overall game speed by 5%.

Please let us know if you encounter these or any other issues. Have fun!
Derek
